channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: “No Kings III” event to be held in Birmingham on March 28
item.description: The ACLU of Alabama and Birmingham Indivisible will host a peaceful rally at Railroad Park to protest racial profiling and defend constitutional rights.

item.title: Opinion | The hidden gift of the detour
item.description: Missed turns often provided more than just lost time; they offered the unexpected stories and perspective that flawless navigation never could.

item.title: Senate committee passes bill to exempt National Guard pay from state taxes
item.description: Alabama senators advanced a tax exemption for National Guard members Wednesday despite warnings that the move would strip millions from state public schools.

item.title: Parkinson’s added to list of firefighter’s occupational diseases advances in both houses
item.description: Committees in both chambers approved measures Wednesday providing disability and death benefits to Alabama firefighters who develop Parkinson’s disease following toxic exposure.

item.title: House committee advances bill requiring Ten Commandments displayed in schools
item.description: Alabama lawmakers advanced legislation requiring a display on the Ten Commandments' influence on U.S. civil society and legal principles.

item.title: Frontrunners keep raking in campaign contributions ahead of May primaries
item.description: Senator Tommy Tuberville raised the most money of all candidates for statewide office, with over $1 million in cash received this February.

item.title: House committees advance school prayer bills
item.description: Two Alabama House committees advanced similar school prayer bills, debating funding penalties, constitutionality concerns and whether schools should mandate daily prayer.

item.title: Governor signs screen time limits for early childhood education programs into law
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey on Wednesday approved a measure to balance digital exposure with hands-on learning for children in licensed child care and prekindergarten facilities.

item.title: Alabama’s gambling misinformation problem is costing us about a billion dollars per year
item.description: Misinformation about gaming laws and regulations continue to plague Alabama's gaming debate, and it's costing us big time.

item.title: New bill would ban Delta THC, remove legal framework for consumable hemp
item.description: Senator Tom Butler proposed classifying hemp-derived cannabinoids as Schedule I drugs, threatening small businesses that recently adapted to new state licensing requirements.
